summary: Diff adds backend storage + admin-only APIs for AdMob config and introduces frontend React Query hooks and Admin Panel wiring for editing/saving AdMob App ID and Rewarded Ad Unit ID. It also changes unrelated UI behavior (admin navigation button) and uses AdMob config in the rewarded-ad stub modal.

hallucinated_features.description: Rewarded Ad stub modal now fetches and displays admin-configured AdMob IDs (fallback to placeholders).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to display/edit/save AdMob settings in the Admin Panel; it did not request wiring other parts of the app (rewarded-ad modal) to those settings.

hallucinated_features.description: App header adds an authenticated-admin-only navigation button to toggle between VPN Panel and Admin Panel via hash routing.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request changes to global navigation/header behavior; scope was limited to Admin Panel fields + backend APIs + React Query wiring.
